Posting my texts to Pastebin is handy for sharing talking points with those who already agree with me, but it's hardly efficient for spreading the message for those who need to hear it. This is exacerbated by the recent measures by the US government to censor "propaganda" and "fake news," as well as the longstanding problem of reluctance to listen to anything that could be construed as racist.

But I have a plan. I am going to take some of what I've written, add new content, and shuffle around the text into something that can be easily digested even by those unwilling to hear what I have to say. And it will be delivered in a manner that can be easily accessed -- a website with its own URL, perhaps. But I will need as much help as I can get. First, the manner in which this message is published will probably cost money. I plan on paying through bitcoin to minimize paper trails, as I plan on preserving my pseudonymity. You can find an address for bitcoin donations on my profile pages at Voat and Gab.ai. (I realize there's no way to guarantee your donation would be used to fund this project. Perhaps you could consider it an expression of gratitude for my work thus far.) Also, if you know of a better bitcoin-accepting service than this, please let me know.

And after this work is complete, I could use assistance in publicizing it. I could especially use help from people who, unlike me, are willing to spread my message under their public identity. You could forward it to people on your email list, casually recommend it in person, and the like.

Any such help would be greatly appreciated. The time of being silenced by political correctness is over. Now we must demand that we either be proven wrong or have our views be accepted as legitimate by our leaders and society.
